mutations.name: fr5-unwired-exits-2
mutations._mechanism: Turn the UNWIRED verdict into an operational failure by returning 2.

mutations.name: wire-check-not-run
mutations._mechanism: Cut the checker subprocess call while retaining verdict handling and assembly.
mutations.find:
check = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, AGY_WIRING_CHECK, "--agy", "--project-root", str(args.project_root)],
                capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=AGY_WIRING_TIMEOUT_S,
            )

mutations.name: wire-check-runs-for-every-agent
mutations._mechanism: Force the agy-only checker to run for codex and grok as well.

mutations.name: halt-marker-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Drop the H-MAD halt marker following the checker verdict.
